sources.entry: Paperless Desktop - Desktop app that uses the paperless API to manage your document scans.

summary.one_liner: Paperless Desktop is a desktop app that uses the paperless API to manage document scans, built with Electron and React.
summary.what_it_does: The app connects to a running paperless instance (the README requires at least v0.4.1) through its API and lets you manage your document scans from the desktop. The README gives few details about specific screens or features. It can be run from source with npm, and a macOS executable can be packaged with an npm script. Pre-built executables are available but are described as pre-releases that still need work. The README names photon, react and electron as credits.
use_cases: manage scanned documents from a desktop app
desktop client for a self-hosted paperless server
package an Electron app for macOS
notable: Desktop client for the paperless document management API
Packages a macOS executable via an npm script
caveats: Requires a running paperless instance of at least v0.4.1
Pre-built executables are pre-releases with work still to do
Author tests only on macOS; other operating systems may behave unexpectedly
